description: PROJECTION POLICY - refuses letting a column be SELECTED rather than changing what it returns (all live-verified): PROJECTION_CONSTRAINT is an ordinary callable whose argument must be named; zero-arg/return-type signature rules; SHOW/DESCRIBE shape with comments; duplicate create refused; ALTER SET BODY; per-column attach with FORCE semantics and positioned refusals; a denied column may not appear in the statement's own select list (aliased, wrapped, starred - offending items upper-cased in the message) yet stays usable in WHERE/aggregates/ORDER BY and in inner selects; UNSET releases (idempotent); attachment in the column definition with GET_DDL rendering; attached policies undroppable until released; PROJECTION stays a name. Converted 1:1 from ddl/ProjectionPolicyTest (now retired).
